notes.primary_contrast: mean paired CRPS(actions-only) - CRPS(signal-aware) of y (high bids in rounds 16-20, normalised by 5n) on the cheap-talk n = 10 cycle runs with full history; positive favours the signal-aware forecast. Absolute CRPS of both is reported; n = 20 and other arms are secondary.
notes.intervals: 95% percentile intervals from 2,000 resamples of whole swarm runs; they are conditional on the fitted audit tables (audit-estimation uncertainty is not included) and treat the model side as fixed.
notes.held_out: the fitted-from-swarm baseline is fitted on runs 1-25 and every predictor is scored on the same runs 26-50; it uses swarm data, so it is not an audit.
notes.delta_and_null: Delta_t is the binned TV between the swarm's R runs and the predictor's fixed reference law (exact at n = 4, else 20,000 simulated runs). Its null reference draws R whole runs from a separate simulation pool against the same law; per_round is pointwise, max_over_rounds simultaneous. Empirical TV has sampling error.
notes.bound: B_t is an estimate of the Theorem 1 bound from logged defects with a whole-run bootstrap interval; it is not a certified bound.
notes.defect_shift: decomposes the local expected one-step error eps(p_swarm) - eps(p_test), not the observed group TV gap; both terms can be negative.
notes.defects: actions_only is a binary-action TV; signal_aware is a six-outcome joint TV; compare them only through one_step (action marginal).

order0.definition: q-quantile of the binned TV between R whole runs from a separate model pool and the fixed reference law; per_round is pointwise, max_over_rounds is simultaneous

actions_only.definition: q-quantile of the binned TV between R whole runs from a separate model pool and the fixed reference law; per_round is pointwise, max_over_rounds is simultaneous

actions_only_equal_w.definition: q-quantile of the binned TV between R whole runs from a separate model pool and the fixed reference law; per_round is pointwise, max_over_rounds is simultaneous

signal_aware.definition: q-quantile of the binned TV between R whole runs from a separate model pool and the fixed reference law; per_round is pointwise, max_over_rounds is simultaneous

signal_aware.measure: six-outcome joint TV over (bid, message); not comparable with the binary measure: use one_step for a like-for-like comparison

one_step.label: one-step (teacher-forced), not a group prediction; both use the action marginal, so they are like for like

held_out.note: runs 26-50 only; fitted_from_swarm uses swarm data (runs 1-25), so it is not an audit
